description: Implement Dashboard screen showing: daily kWh, daily cost PHP, monthly kWh projection, monthly cost PHP, total appliances count, appliance cards with ON/OFF toggles. All values auto-update when appliances, schedules, statuses, or rate change. Depends on FEAT-002 calculations, FEAT-003 storage, FEAT-004 state management.
steps: Create lib/widgets/stat_card.dart - reusable card showing a metric (icon, label, large value with unit). Use consistent Material 3 styling, white background, subtle shadow, green accent.
Create lib/widgets/appliance_card.dart - card showing appliance name, category icon, current wattage, ON/OFF toggle, calculated daily kWh and cost. Toggle changes appliance.isOn state.
Implement DashboardScreen in lib/screens/dashboard_screen.dart as StatefulWidget or Consumer<AppState> if using provider
Fetch AppState (appliances, rate) using provider Consumer or watch()
Calculate using CalculationService: household daily kWh, household daily PHP, household monthly kWh (daily*30), household monthly PHP (daily*30)
Display 4 stat cards: daily kWh, daily PHP, monthly kWh, monthly PHP using stat_card.dart
Display scrollable list of appliance_card widgets for each appliance
Wrap entire content in SingleChildScrollView for mobile
Wrap appliance ON/OFF toggle to update AppState.appliances and trigger persistence
Add auto-refresh: use FutureBuilder or Timer to recalculate when rate changes (AppState listener)
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays 4 metric cards: daily kWh, daily PHP, monthly kWh, monthly PHP
All values calculated using CalculationService from actual appliance data
Appliance cards show wattage, ON/OFF toggle, and calculated per-appliance consumption
Toggling appliance ON/OFF updates the state and recalculates all metrics immediately
Changing electricity rate (in Settings) updates all displayed costs immediately
Values are labeled as estimates (e.g., 'Est. Daily Consumption')
UI uses Material 3 theme with green accent
Flutter analyze shows no errors, no console warnings
verification: Run: flutter analyze lib/screens/dashboard_screen.dart lib/widgets/ — no errors

Run: flutter run and manually verify: Dashboard tab displays correct metrics, toggle a fan ON/OFF and see daily kWh/cost update, navigate to Settings and change rate, return to Dashboard and see costs recalculated
